name: NAOH: Arcade Collection
author: KiddRwxSsj
description: NAOH: Arcade Collection is a native PlayStation Vita arcade launcher written in C. It statically links the FB Alpha 2012 (CPS2) and MAME 2000 libretro cores behind a custom vita2d-rendered front end, so a set of classic Marvel vs Capcom arcade games can be launched and played.
